definition.name: Pinned LLVM21 stack and TLS context control only

steps.name: Build only the parser and C context source mechanism
steps.run:
cargo test --locked -p latent-component-threading --lib --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-context-tools"
cargo build --locked -p latent-component-threading --bin c-context --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-context-tools"

steps.name: Execute fixed C compiler and actual core-Wasm callback controls
Install only the pinned normal C bindings generator
Link one selected C core and authenticate its real canonical ABI graph
steps.run: python3 tools/qualify_c_canonical_abi.py --zig "$(command -v zig)" --wit-bindgen "$(command -v wit-bindgen)" --wasm-tools "$(command -v wasm-tools)" --node "$(command -v node)" --transformer "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-context-tools/debug/c-context" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-canonical-abi"

steps.name: Retain source mechanism observations, including failure

with.name: c-context-mechanism-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/report.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/*.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/*.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/*.ll
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/selected/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/selected/*.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/tls-keys/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/tls-keys/*.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/tss/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/tss/*.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/c-canonical-abi/report.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-canonical-abi/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-canonical-abi/*.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/c-canonical-abi/*.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/c-canonical-abi/selected/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-canonical-abi/selected/*.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/c-canonical-abi/generated/bindings/*
${{ runner.temp }}/c-canonical-abi/generated/wit/**/*.wit

reviewReason: Reviewed security fork identities only; commands, permissions, inputs, conditions and historical coverage are preserved.
